subject.title: Config: scaffold compaction loop guard settings

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public `agents.defaults.compaction.guard` namespace before runtime semantics land, or wait for the canonical saturated-session guard design?
rationale: This PR adds new public config/default surface for session-state recovery behavior, and repository policy treats config/default additions as compatibility-sensitive product/API decisions.

options.title: Wait for runtime contract
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged until maintainers define the guard namespace, defaults, runtime consumer, and reset-recommendation semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48238.

options.title: Approve staged config API
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the inert config scaffold as a reserved API and own the compatibility cost until runtime behavior lands.

options.title: Close or narrow this PR
options.body: If staged config is not desired, close this PR or ask for a new branch that only adds the runtime-backed subset maintainers want now.

recommendation.title: Wait for runtime contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR unmerged until maintainers define the guard namespace, defaults, runtime consumer, and reset-recommendation semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48238.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on compaction safeguard schema and adjacent post-compaction guard policy.
